description: Extract the main keywords or tags from one block of text using Cloudflare Workers AI. Input is text, with optional max_keywords (default 8, cap 20). The answer returns a ranked list of short keywords or phrases, carries the model name, and is flagged machine_generated rather than verified. The ranking reflects the model judgement and is not deterministic across calls. Use it to tag documents or see what a text is about. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.00 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。
name: keywords
